survey_questions.question_text: What is your facility's continuous off-shift baseload electrical draw as a percentage of peak daytime demand?

options.label: Severe (>68% of peak) — Heavy equipment and HVAC run continuously unthrottled
Moderate (45% - 68% of peak) — Basic manual shutdown routines with noticeable parasitic draw
Optimized (<45% of peak) — Automated BMS setbacks, sleep states, and variable primary pumps
Unmetered / Unknown — Only aggregate monthly utility bill available without 15-min interval data

survey_questions.question_text: What is the chilled water supply/return temperature differential (ΔT) across your central chiller plant?

options.label: Degraded Low ΔT (<6°F / 3.3°C) — Frequent staging of excess chillers just to meet flow demand
Standard Constant Volume (7°F - 9°F) — Fixed setpoints with 3-way bypass valves
High-Efficiency Variable Primary Flow (≥12°F / 6.7°C) — Active VFD staging & reset control
No Central Chilled Water Plant — Direct expansion (DX) rooftop packaged units only

survey_questions.question_text: When was your plant compressed air distribution system last audited with ultrasonic leak detection?

options.label: Never or >18 months ago — System runs near maximum duty cycle continuously
6 - 18 months ago — Periodic tag-and-repair maintenance program in place
Continuous Acoustic IoT Monitoring or <6 months audit with pressure dew point control
Facility does not use centralized industrial compressed air

survey_questions.question_text: At what Cycles of Concentration (CoC) do your evaporative cooling towers operate before blowdown purge?

options.label: Low (<3.2 CoC) — Dumping high volume makeup water due to hard water scaling fears
Standard (3.5 - 5.0 CoC) — Automated conductivity bleed valve with chemical inhibitor dosing
High Efficiency (≥6.5 CoC) — Acid feed / softening pre-treatment with side-stream filtration
No Evaporative Cooling Towers — Closed-loop glycol adiabatic dry coolers only

survey_questions.question_text: What proportion of process rinse water, reverse osmosis (RO) reject, or condensate is recycled on-site?

options.label: 0% — 100% of RO reject and rinse discharge flows directly into municipal industrial sewer
15% - 40% — Condensate and single rinse tanks captured for secondary washdown use
>60% — Dedicated ultrafiltration/RO closed-loop reclamation and rainwater cistern system

survey_questions.question_text: What is your audited plant-wide solid waste landfill diversion rate over the past 12 months?

options.label: <35% Diversion — Majority of manufacturing packaging and production scrap enters general landfill compactors
35% - 70% Diversion — Cardboard and scrap metals recycled; mixed plastics and organics landfilled
>85% Diversion (Zero Waste Target) — Segregated polymer baling, composting, and circular remanufacturing

survey_questions.question_text: How are industrial solvents, degreasers, and process cutting fluids managed?

options.label: Hauled off-site for high-temperature hazardous thermal incineration without material recovery
Blended off-site for secondary industrial kiln fuel substitution
On-site closed-loop fractional vacuum distillation or switched to water-based bio-degreasers
Process does not utilize hazardous chemical solvents or oils

analysis_results.primary_concern: High electricity bill & off-peak chiller load
analysis_results.probable_root_cause: Chiller units running at 85% capacity between 11 PM and 4 AM on weekends due to override timers not resetting.
analysis_results.company_need: Automated BMS HVAC Scheduling Override & Submetering Telemetry.
analysis_results.reasoning: Calculated baseline energy usage indicates continuous night-time HVAC load despite 0% workforce occupancy on weekends. Over-chilling causes 18.4 metric tons of avoidable CO2 emissions annually.
analysis_results.trade_offs: Low upfront software configuration cost ($1,200) vs minimal operational disruption (requires 2-hour weekend calibration window).

recommendations.title: Automated BMS HVAC Scheduling & Reset Override
recommendations.description: Program smart override timers to power down facility chillers during off-peak weekend windows.

recommendations.title: Establish Dedicated Organic Composting Pipeline
recommendations.description: Divert organic food waste from landfill compactors into municipal industrial composting.

recommendations.title: Cooling Tower Closed-Loop Recirculation Upgrade
recommendations.description: Install submetering and filtration loop to recycle blowdown water.
